product_one_liner.value: Druid provides an enterprise AI-agent platform for organizations to build and deploy agents that automate complex business processes across enterprise systems.
product_one_liner.notes: Druid describes itself as an enterprise AI-agent platform and says it routes work among agents, enterprise systems, and people to complete end-to-end processes.

pricing_page.notes: The company has a public pricing page describing custom pricing plans, so the existence of the page qualifies even though plans are quote-based.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Both MatrixCare and Liberty Global are named on Druid AI's customer/logo page. | named_customers.0: MatrixCare appears by name on Druid AI's customer/logo page. | named_customers.1: Liberty Global appears by name on Druid AI's customer/logo page.

employee_band.notes: A November 4, 2026 company hiring profile estimates 216 employees, placing Druid in the 201-500 band. Other public headcount signals are estimates and some differ, so this is the best current band rather than an exact official count.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company profile gives the locality as New York, NY. | hq_country: The company's LinkedIn profile identifies its country as the United States and its locality as New York, NY.

founded_year.notes: Druid AI's careers page states that the company was founded in 2018.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index and inspected archive pages are dominated by industry guides, use cases, customer stories, and marketing thought leadership. The reference-model article is by Michael Yang, whose profile identifies him as Chief Strategy Officer; the index does not show two engineering-authored posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: Druid's public documentation portal lists multiple product guides, solution articles, integration topics, and release notes, meeting the multi-article requirement.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The November 4, 2026 open-role inventory lists Senior Developer Advocate and Account Executive roles, while the company careers page shows a Technical Consultant role; none is an AI/ML or data-science role title (and sales roles do not qualify).

model_provider.value: Model-agnostic; the product says it supports Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google models, LLaMA, Mistral, Druid Becus, and custom models.
model_provider.notes: Druid's public platform materials describe the product as model-agnostic and name Azure OpenAI, Claude, Gemini/Google models, LLaMA, Mistral, Druid Becus, and custom models as available choices.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Druid AI's governance page labels these as supported compliance certifications and names SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001:2022, GDPR, and HIPAA; these are the relevant named items from the requested list. | compliance_certs.0: The governance page names SOC 2 Type II. | compliance_certs.1: The governance page names ISO 27001:2022. | compliance_certs.2: The governance page names HIPAA. | compliance_certs.3: The governance page names GDPR.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The latest disclosed funding round is explicitly identified as a Series C. | funding_date: The latest disclosed Series C round is dated September 16, 2025, which maps to 2025-09. | funding_amount_usd: The funding profile identifies the latest round as a $31 million Series C dated September 16, 2025, consistent with Druid AI's own dated announcement. A later investor-page headline is inconsistent, but current funding profiles do not show a later disclosed round.

raised_18mo.notes: Druid AI announced its $31 million Series C on September 16, 2025, which falls within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live Druid AI Account Executive posting remained open until November 14, 2026, so it was open on November 9, 2026.

launched_6mo.notes: The dated Business Wire announcement (its URL is dated 2026-10-14) says Druid AI announced new voice, interoperability, governance, and evaluation capabilities, inside the six-month window before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Michael Yang is identified as Druid AI's Chief Strategy Officer, and the profile gives his start date as December 1, 2025, within the 12 months preceding November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: A Druid AI account-executive job posting explicitly says account and opportunity information is maintained in HubSpot. | crm_stack_signal.0: The account-executive posting explicitly names HubSpot.
